question: What was the theme for World Environment Day (5 June 2025)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beat Plastic Pollution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **World Environment Day 2025** is centered around the theme **"Beat Plastic Pollution"** (often associated with the global effort to "End Plastic Pollution"), highlighting the urgent need for global cooperation to eliminate plastic waste. ***Hence, the correct answer is Beat Plastic Pollution.***
 
• The **Republic of Korea** has been announced as the global host for **World Environment Day** on **5 June 2025**. This event is particularly significant as it precedes the finalization of a **legally binding international instrument** on plastic pollution.
 
• The **2025** campaign focuses on accelerating the transition to a **circular economy**, where plastic is redesigned, reused, and recycled rather than discarded into the environment.
